dialogues.speaker: Ms. Yu
dialogues.text: How about it? If there's work you're interested in, you can get started right away.

dialogues.speaker: Ms. Yu
dialogues.text: If you're able to successfully complete the work, not only will you gain reputation, but there will be rewards awaiting you as well. It will definitely be worth your while.

dialogues.speaker: Ms. Yu
dialogues.text: Still, the work you can take on is dependent on your reputation.

dialogues.speaker: Ms. Yu
dialogues.text: Given that you're just starting out, you will most likely only be able to take fairly routine tasks for now.

dialogues.speaker: Ms. Yu
dialogues.text: But if you would like to try your hand at more important tasks and see better rewards, then you'll have to earn the trust of others. I'd suggest taking as much work as you can.
